description: Oracle Database enterprise administration and PL/SQL: Packages, Triggers, Tablespace management, Range/List/Hash partitioning, Execution Plan tuning with DBMS_XPLAN, and Autonomous Transactions.
instructionsMarkdown:
# Oracle Database & PL/SQL Enterprise Architecture

Design and optimize high-throughput Oracle Database instances and structured PL/SQL packages.

## Key Principles & Invariants
- Always use bind variables in dynamic queries to ensure shared pool cursor caching and eradicate hard parsing.
- Decompose code into modular PL/SQL Package specifications (`.pks`) and bodies (`.pkb`).
- Implement table partitioning (Range/Hash) and verify partition pruning via `DBMS_XPLAN.DISPLAY_CURSOR`.
- Restrict `PRAGMA AUTONOMOUS_TRANSACTION` solely to logging and auditing routines.
